DOWN 35 AFTER THE ENTERPRISE REBASE, RE-STAMPED AT 401369e7fe3. 152 before, 117 after 28 upstream commits arrived -- the largest single move in this sweep, and in the direction CLAUDE.md section 4 predicts for a floor that survived a rebase: it was banked before upstream's improvements got here. Like naming_enterprise this counts specific offences rather than summing a tree, so the decrease is 35 sites repaired upstream and not headroom bought elsewhere. Re-measured in a clean detached worktree laid out beside a clean odoo worktree.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

STAMP REFRESHED, NUMBER UNCHANGED. The old stamp named a commit the 2026-09-02 sync replayed away, so --list flagged it ORPHANED-BASE and the sibling architecture.yml exited 2 asking to be re-measured rather than comparing -- neither green nor red. Re-measured in a clean detached worktree of enterprise at f6fa11352db, laid out beside a clean odoo worktree exactly as the lane does, because these gates resolve the community fork as a sibling and reading one alone inflates the count: unresolved_calls_enterprise measured 11 pointed at the sibling on its own and 3 in the pair.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

STAMPED, NOT MOVED. The floor carried no `measured_at` at all, so it was a number nobody could reproduce: the guard that refuses a stamp this branch never had cannot fire on a floor with no stamp, and an unstamped floor may never have been true of any tree. Re-measured on a clean detached worktree at the stamped commit -- python odoo/tooling/architecture/order_line_qty.py --roots enterprise --count -- and it reads 152, equal to the floor. The count does not move; only the stamp does. A sibling floor's stamp is the SIBLING's commit, recorded through `--update --root enterprise` from a clean detached worktree of that checkout, so it resolves in the repository that was actually measured.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

First baseline for this scope. `architecture.yml` in the community fork invokes order_line_qty.py without `--roots`, so it measures `odoo/` and `addons/` and this repository was checked by nothing -- a regression here was caught by nothing and a fix here credited by nothing.
